title: Community PWS Service Areas
description: This feature layer represents areas likely served by public water in Connecticut.  This layer provides information on community public water systems, which is defined as a water system that serves 25 or more residents.  Water systems that only serve non-residential customers are not included in this layer.  This data is compiled from submissions to the Connecticut Department of Public Health by public water systems.  The data is buffered. The buffers may vary from system to system based on what was provided by the public water systems.  Some of the data may be in excess of 10 years old and may not represent current status.  Not every property shown in a service area is necessarily served by public water.  Specific information on a property can be provided by the public water system.
snippet: Service areas of community public water systems in Connecticut
